held.why: held: not the program's own: its blocks are the 'Emphasis in Coastal Science Technician' of the Geosciences Technician degree ('General Studies – 26-30 Unit Emphasis', SC Program AS.1602, 18626's), whose heading page read 45953358884 prints on PDF p.77 above the list on p.78; pp.76-79 and the pages 45837455365 printed between pp.74 and 100 carry no 'Coastal Oceanographic' heading, so the 2026-2027 catalog is not shown to print this program: a rule D capture, then a prior-year read (kb/_program_discontinued.py)

records.words: the courses' units add to 23-27, within the printed 22-27 units

program.section_heading: Associate in Arts in Kinesiology for Transfer Degree (section heading printed on the preceding page; text begins mid-section on page 100)
outcomes: Identify and apply the scientific principles of movement, exercise, and sport including the knowledge and skill in the listed activity course families of fitness, aquatics, individual sport and team sport.

blocks.name: LIST A (Choose two courses from the following)

live_run_proof.how: the hosting API's commits by path on main

representation: checks.gaps and checks.confidence added as the load reads the filed score (a passing row: checks.arithmetic to equal); checks.coverage, invented and the record unchanged
claim_check_reads: Today's capture (sources.json): every course an entry names among the codes it found, and a course an entry says the printed total leaves out on neither it nor the state's list. A note's quoted figures are the reader's words, never re-read here.
follow_verdict: The follow_verdict trigger marks a row checked when its latest verdict is a confirm whose fingerprint matches the record and the machine checks pass. The record is unchanged here, so such a confirm on a row this plan moves to passing would check it at the apply, and the rollback would skip it. The pre-read counts those rows (confirm_matches); the apply aborts, writing nothing, unless the count is 0.
